original_query: with frequent_ss_items as  (select substring(i_item_desc,1,30) itemdesc,i_item_sk item_sk,d_date solddate,count(*) cnt   from store_sales       ,date_dim       ,item   where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk     and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk     and d_year = 2001     and i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 and 96      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Jewelry', 'Sports')   group by substring(i_item_desc,1,30),i_item_sk,d_date   having count(*) >4),  max_store_sales as  (select max(csales) tpcds_cmax   from (select c_customer_sk,sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) csales         from store_sales             ,customer             ,date_dim         where ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk          and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and d_year = 2001          and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12         group by c_customer_sk) tmp1),  best_ss_customer as  (select c_customer_sk,sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) ssales   from store_sales       ,customer   where ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk   and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1983   group by c_customer_sk   having sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) > (95/100.0) * (select   * from  max_store_sales))   select  sum(sales)  from (select cs_quantity*cs_list_price sales        from catalog_sales            ,date_dim        where d_year = 2001          and d_moy = 10          and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and cs_item_sk in (select item_sk from frequent_ss_items)          and cs_bill_customer_sk in (select c_customer_sk from best_ss_customer)          and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12       union all       select ws_quantity*ws_list_price sales        from web_sales            ,date_dim        where d_year = 2001          and d_moy = 10          and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and ws_item_sk in (select item_sk from frequent_ss_items)          and ws_bill_customer_sk in (select c_customer_sk from best_ss_customer)          and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12) tmp2  limit 100;
rewritten_query:
with frequent_ss_items as
  (select distinct ss.ss_item_sk item_sk
   from store_sales ss
        join date_dim d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        join item i on ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   where d.d_year = 2001
     and i.i_manager_id between 77 and 96
     and i.i_category in ('Books', 'Jewelry', 'Sports')
   group by ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_date
   having count(*) > 4),
 max_store_sales as
  (select max(csales) tpcds_cmax
   from (select ss.ss_customer_sk,
                sum(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) csales
         from store_sales ss
              join date_dim d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
         where d.d_year = 2001
           and ss.ss_wholesale_cost between 2 and 12
           and ss.ss_customer_sk is not null
         group by ss.ss_customer_sk) t),
 best_ss_customer as
  (select ss.ss_customer_sk c_customer_sk
   from store_sales ss
        join customer c on ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   where c.c_birth_year between 1977 and 1983
   group by ss.ss_customer_sk
   having sum(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price)
          > 0.95 * (select tpcds_cmax from max_store_sales))
select sum(sales)
from (select cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price sales
      from catalog_sales cs
           join date_dim d on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
           join frequent_ss_items f on cs.cs_item_sk = f.item_sk
           join best_ss_customer b on cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = b.c_customer_sk
      where d.d_year = 2001
        and d.d_moy = 10
        and cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 2 and 12
      union all
      select ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price sales
      from web_sales ws
           join date_dim d on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
           join frequent_ss_items f on ws.ws_item_sk = f.item_sk
           join best_ss_customer b on ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = b.c_customer_sk
      where d.d_year = 2001
        and d.d_moy = 10
        and ws.ws_wholesale_cost between 2 and 12) tmp2;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Pruned unused CTE output columns (itemdesc, solddate, cnt, ssales) and kept only the keys needed by the final query, reducing materialized CTE width.

Deduplicated frequent_ss_items with DISTINCT item_sk so the CTE is unique per item; removed the redundant LIMIT 100 after a single-row aggregate; replaced IN subqueries with direct joins to the deduplicated CTEs, eliminating repeated HashAggregate steps in each branch.

Removed the redundant customer join in max_store_sales (c_customer_sk == ss_customer_sk under TPC-DS referential integrity; IS NOT NULL preserves NULL handling). Grouped by ss_customer_sk directly in both sales aggregations. Rewrote comma joins as explicit JOIN syntax.

Converted the IN-semijoins on frequent_ss_items and best_ss_customer into inner joins with unique CTE outputs (no row duplication) and used explicit join conditions for catalog_sales/web_sales, date_dim, item, and customer.
Replaced (95/100.0) with the literal 0.95; i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 and 96 and cost ranges kept as folded range predicates.
